sections.heading: Luvdisc Swarms
body: In Pokemon HeartGold and SoulSilver, Luvdisc swarms become available after obtaining the National Pokedex. Check Professor Oak's Pokemon Talk radio program for the current swarm.

Luvdisc can hold Heart Scales. Put a fainted Pokemon with Compound Eyes in the first party slot to improve held-item odds, then use a Pokemon with Thief in the second party slot to take the Heart Scale.
